cwe_assessments.review_comment: The added esprima.parse() call processes user-controlled JavaScript code without size or complexity limits, creating a potential denial-of-service vector. While the Function() constructor provides some syntax validation, it doesn't prevent resource exhaustion attacks. Implement input size limits and consider adding timeout mechanisms for parser operations to mitigate resource consumption risks.
